findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages all missed July 31 deadline — 28 days overdue; no paid channel has ever spent $1.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting both missed August 1 deadline — 27 days overdue; zero impressions, zero leads across all paid channels.
GBP actions fell to 0 on Aug 24, 26, and 27 — last 3 days average 0.67 vs prior 3-day average of 1.33, a 50% drop inside a broader -56.52% 7d decline.
GHL shows 110 contacts and 12 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won — intake pipeline exists but no consults are booking, intake leak likely.
